key_rationale: While headline CPI inflation at 4.85% remains within the tolerance band, the persistence of food inflation at 8.52% and elevated global crude oil prices at $90.45 per barrel necessitate continued vigilance. Maintaining the current repo rate of 6.50% and the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to durably align inflation with the 4.00% target while supporting the ongoing growth momentum of 6.30% GVA.
